title_en: High-Speed Rail: China and the US
note_en: Comparisons in this text often use 相比之下 "by contrast" and 而 to join contrasting clauses: 中国的高铁技术大多是自己设计制造的，而美国的高速列车更依赖外国公司的技术 "China's technology is mostly homegrown, while America's trains rely more on foreign companies' technology." 而 here works like English "while" or "whereas," but it sits at the start of the second clause only, with no word needed in the first.
